speaker: alice
text: So Alex, it is peak whale season out at Hervey Bay right now, and the humpbacks are putting on an absolute show as they cruise down the Queensland coast with their calves in tow. Whale watching boats have been packed out and honestly, there's nothing quite like watching a forty tonne animal fling itself out of the water for no reason other than it can.

speaker: charlie
text: Love that for them honestly, showing off a bit before winter's properly done. Meanwhile back on land, Queensland keeps quietly smashing it on renewables, with big batteries and household solar panels popping up all over the place as the state chases its clean energy targets.

speaker: alice
text: It's the sort of steady, unglamorous progress that doesn't always make headlines but it adds up, panel by panel and battery by battery. Good stuff all round for Mother Nature this week.
